The local proxy is an advanced feature. Make sure you understand how it works before turning it on.

Check the documentation or ask your provider how to configure it.

failover.title: Turn on Switch automatically
failover.message:
With Switch automatically on, an app is served from its switching order instead of the one provider you picked, and moves down the list when a request fails.

Set up the switching order first.

usage.title: Configure Usage Query
usage.message:
Usage queries need a custom script or API parameters from your provider.

If you are not sure how to set it up, check your provider's documentation first.

streamCheck.title: Model Health Check
streamCheck.message:
The health check sends a direct API request to test the provider. It can fail for:

• Official providers (OAuth login, no standalone API key)
• Some relay services (they check that requests come from Claude Code CLI)
• AWS Bedrock (IAM signature authentication)

A failed check does not mean the provider is unusable, only that a standalone request could not verify it. Go by how it behaves in the app.

accountPool.enabledDescription: With Switch automatically on, an Official account whose usage reaches the threshold is moved to the back of the switching order until its limit resets, so the session carries on with the next account. Applies to Claude and Codex.
accountPool.thresholdDescription: Pass an account over once its usage reaches this level — its account-wide usage, or its usage of the model being requested where that model has a limit of its own (Fable does; Opus and Sonnet share the account's). 50–100.
accountPool.keepWarmDescription: When an Official account's session window has lapsed, send it one single-token request, so it is already inside a window when rotation reaches it and its login is renewed rather than left to go stale. Spends a little quota with nobody present, which is why it is off. Claude and Codex, while Switchy is running.
accountPool.keepWarmIntervalDescription: How often each account is considered. A request goes out only when that account's window has lapsed and the account is not at its limit, so the cost stays near one request per account per window. 15–1440.

agentTooltip.sisyphus: Main orchestrator: plans, delegates and runs tasks in parallel. Uses extended thinking (32k budget) and works through TODO lists until the task is done.
agentTooltip.atlas: Main orchestrator (holds TODO list) responsible for task distribution and coordination during execution phase. Delegates to specialized agents rather than completing all work directly.
agentTooltip.prometheus: Strategic planner that collects requirements through interview mode and creates detailed work plans. Can only read/write Markdown files in .sisyphus/ directory, never writes code directly.
agentTooltip.hephaestus: Autonomous deep worker ("legitimate craftsman") inspired by AmpCode deep mode. Goal-oriented execution that launches 2-5 explore/librarian agents in parallel for research before taking action.
agentTooltip.oracle: Advisor for architecture decisions and debugging. Read-only: it reasons through problems and analyzes them in depth, but cannot write files or delegate tasks.
agentTooltip.librarian: Analyzes multiple repositories and retrieves documentation. Gives evidence-based answers and is good at finding official docs and open-source examples.
agentTooltip.explore: Fast codebase exploration and context grep. Uses lightweight models for quick searches to map the code structure.
agentTooltip.multimodalLooker: Visual content expert that analyzes PDFs, images, charts and other non-text media, extracting information and insights from them.
agentTooltip.metis: Plan consultant that performs pre-analysis before planning. Identifies hidden intents, ambiguities and AI failure points to prevent over-engineering.
agentTooltip.momus: Checks plans for clarity, verifiability and completeness, and sends them back for revision until they hold up.
agentTooltip.sisyphusJunior: Category-generated executor, automatically created via category parameters. Focuses on executing assigned tasks and cannot re-delegate, preventing infinite delegation loops.

categoryTooltip.visualEngineering: Frontend and visual engineering category for UI/UX design, styling, animation and interface implementation. Defaults to Gemini 3 Pro model.
categoryTooltip.ultrabrain: Deep logical reasoning category for complex architectural decisions requiring extensive analysis. Defaults to GPT-5.3 Codex ultra-high reasoning variant.
categoryTooltip.deep: Deep autonomous problem-solving category with goal-oriented execution. Conducts thorough research before action, suitable for difficult problems requiring deep understanding.
categoryTooltip.artistry: For creative and artistic tasks that call for novel ideas. Defaults to the Gemini 3 Pro max variant.
categoryTooltip.quick: Lightweight task category for single-file modifications, typo fixes, and simple adjustments. Defaults to Claude Haiku 4.5 fast model.
categoryTooltip.unspecifiedLow: Uncategorized low-effort task category for tasks that don't fit other categories with small workload. Defaults to Claude Sonnet 4.5.
categoryTooltip.unspecifiedHigh: Uncategorized high-effort task category for tasks that don't fit other categories with large workload. Defaults to Claude Opus 4.6 max variant.
categoryTooltip.writing: Writing category for documentation, prose and technical writing. Defaults to Gemini 3 Flash fast generation model.

slimAgentTooltip.orchestrator: Writes executable code, orchestrates multi-agent workflow, summons experts
slimAgentTooltip.oracle: Root cause analysis, architecture review, debugging guidance (read-only)
slimAgentTooltip.explorer: Regex search, AST pattern matching, file discovery (read-only)
